[1] [Remote.com > **Clear benefits, real support** > **Hungary 🇭🇺**]
Below is the information related to Hungary's statutory leave policies. Please note that team members hired in Hungary are hired via Remote (PEO) and you should always check with Remote first for the most up to date information.

**Statutory General Entitlement**

**Maternity Leave**

- Team members can take up to 24 weeks of Maternity Leave. The leave must start 4 weeks prior to the scheduled due date.

**Paternity Leave**

- Team members can take 5 days of Paternity Leave or 7 days in case of twins.

**Parental Leave:** Team members can take unpaid leave to care for their child until the child reaches the age of 3 or until the child reaches the age of 10 if the team member receives child care allowance. Team members are also entitled to extra vacation days based on the number of children they have:

- two working days for one child;
- four working days for two children;
- a total of seven working days for more than two children under sixteen years of age.

**Payroll Process**

**Maternity Leave Payment**

- The team member will receive Pregnancy and Confinement Benefit (CSED) at a rate of 70% of their salary for 24 weeks.
- If [eligible](/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave), pay will be supplemented up to 100% pay (minus any CSED benefits received) for up to 16 weeks.

**Paternity Leave Payment**

[2] [Remote.com > **Clear benefits, real support** > **Hungary 🇭🇺**]
- Team members will receive payment from the Hungarian State Treasury for 5 days of their leave.
- If [eligible](/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave), pay will be supplemented up to 100% pay (minus State Treasury benefits) for up to 16 weeks.

**Applying for Parental Leave in Hungary** To initiate your parental leave, submit your time off by selecting the Parental Leave category in Workday at least 30 days before your leave starts.

[3] [Global Expansion > **Global Expansion Benefits** > Denmark 🇩🇰]
Application Deadlines: You must apply for maternity/paternity benefits no later than:

- 8 weeks after childbirth (if not receiving pay)
- 8 weeks after your salary stops (if receiving partial pay)
- 8 weeks after your leave starts (e.g., unpaid paternity leave)
For detailed information regarding statutory/maternity benefits, review the Danish government [website](https://lifeindenmark.borger.dk/family-and-children/family-benefits/maternity-paternity-benefits?frm1=micro-articles-list-e4b24037-c8b4-4132-b97b-90e39d1d895b&frm2=micro-articles-list-a9dba0b7-ac1d-4f9f-9911-c66cf0eedb45).

**Denmark Other Leave Policies**

- **Adoption Leave**: Adoptive parents are entitled to 4 weeks of leave prior to receiving the child, if the adoptive parents have to reside outside of Denmark to adopt. If the child is adopted in Denmark, and it is necessary to reside where the place child is situation, parents are eligible for one week of leave before the adoption. In all cases of adoption, one of the adoptive parents is entitled to adoption leave of 14 weeks and the other with to leave with statutory benefits for 2 weeks. The remaining 12 weeks can be split between the adoptive parents.
- **Care leave(omsorgsdage)**: Intended to allow team members to care for a sick child. This is not a statutory requirement, but is common.

[4] [Remote.com > **Clear benefits, real support** > **Hungary 🇭🇺**]
**Contact:** help@remote.com
**Platform:** [Remote.com Hungary Portal](https://remote.com/)

All benefits listed below are administered and managed by Remote, providing healthcare options and comprehensive parental leave support.

Hungary Medical Coverage

Enhanced healthcare options through Allianz private insurance to complement Hungary's social security system.

**Key Features**

- **Team Member Coverage:** Available through Remote
- **Dependent Coverage:** Effective 1 May 2026, $133.91 USD per month for a partner and $66.96 USD per month for children under 18.
- **Enrollment Window:** 30 days from start date, however if this window is missed team members can connect with remote, to check if the option can be unlocked. This may depend on circumstances.
- **Management:** Through [ThanksBen platform](https://www.thanksben.com/)

Hungary Social Security

**Coverage:** Hungarian Social Security Act provides employer and team member contributions covering pension, health insurance, and unemployment benefits.

**Pension:** Minimum pension available with 20 years of service at HUF 28,500 monthly, or If the average contribution base is less than the amount of the minimum pension, the pension will equal 100% of the average monthly wage.

**Life Insurance:** Access through [Social Insurance System](https://www.allamkincstar.gov.hu/) for illness, injury, or disability coverage.

Hungary Statutory Leave Policies

[5] [Global Expansion > **Global Expansion Benefits** > Denmark 🇩🇰]
**Denmark Pregnancy, Maternity and Paternity Leave**

In total, parents in Denmark get 52 weeks of paid parental leave. The leave entitlement is structured as follows:

**Maternity Leave: For Mothers**

- 4 weeks of pregnancy leave: Can be taken up to 4 weeks before the due date, with maternity/paternity benefits.
- 2 weeks after birth: Must be taken immediately after birth and cannot be transferred to the other parent.
- 8 weeks at birth: Must be taken within the first 10 weeks after the child is born; can be extended if returning to part-time work. This leave can be transferred to the other parent if they meet the conditions for receiving maternity/paternity benefits.
- 9 weeks of leave: Cannot be transferred; must be taken within 1 year of the child's birth unless prevented by special circumstances.
- 5 weeks of leave: Must be taken within 1 year, but can be extended or postponed until the child reaches age 9 if conditions are met. This leave can be transferred to the other parent if they meet the conditions for receiving maternity/paternity benefits.

**Total for mothers**: 4 weeks pregnancy + 24 weeks maternity leave (with 13 weeks transferable under certain conditions)

**Paternity Leave: For Fathers or Co-Mothers**

[6] [Global Expansion > **Global Expansion Benefits** > **Clear benefits, real support**]
- **Entitlement:** 25 days per year
- **First Year:** Prorated for first 6 months, full entitlement from 7th month
- **Ongoing:** Full entitlement from beginning of each work year

**Parental Leave**

- **Maternity:** 16 weeks (8 weeks before delivery, 8 weeks after; extendable to 12 weeks for high-risk births)
- **Parental:** Up to 24 months for both parents, minimum 2 months. The parent should live in the same household as the child.
- **Dismissal Protection:** Up to 4 weeks after the end of the parental leave.
- **Childcare Allowance:** Available through social security during parental leave (Kinderbetreuungsgeld)

**How to Apply** Submit parental leave requests via [Workday - Time Off](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ZatJdGp485lOS2QVrxYJByQK8dD_CMGiLVOykgd338w/edit) at least 30 days before starting leave. Review [GitLab's Parental Leave policy for complete details.](/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave)

**Sick Leave**

- **Reporting Requirements:** Team members must notify their employer immediately if they are unable to work due to illness or injury. If the absence lasts longer than three consecutive calendar days, a medical certificate (Krankenstandsbestätigung) from a doctor must be provided.
- **Pay:** Team members continue to receive full salary for a specified period, which is based on tenure. After the employer-paid period, team members can receive statutory sick pay benefits the Austrian Health Insurance Fund (ÖGK).
